verdicts.note: Missing closing quotation mark in the Tip.
Tip used 'intersect', which is not taught; reworded as keeping the values that satisfy all conditions.
Title said whole numbers m, n but the example uses m = -3; m is now any integer.
Watch-out line was garbled and confusing (ln x / ln y called a change of base without saying why); replaced with the two real slips ln(xy) = ln x ln y and ln(x/y) = ln x / ln y.
Example said f touches y = 0 at the origin, but x/(x^2+1) changes sign there and so crosses it; 'as often as it likes' overstated. Both corrected.
Pen example was unexplained (perimeter 40 never stated) and duplicated the pen problem card; replaced with a depreciation example showing input and parameters.
